notes.title: Update 0.2.0.261U
notes.content: [p]Welcome back, Employee 627![/p][p][/p][p]It has been a while since the last update, but now the update is finally here! [/p][p]... [/p][p]Well... At least on the unstable branch that is.[/p][p][/p][p]This unstable update will undergo a bunch of updated before hitting the stable branch, so always feel free to talk about it in the Discord or in the Steam Community Forum if you like something or don't like something![/p][p][/p][p]A full changelog is right below![/p][p]As always, you can be part of the development on the Discord server!  [/p][p][b]Update Version 0.2.0.261U:[/b][/p][p] [/p][h2]⚡ Features / Content added & changes[/h2][list][*][p]Disabled Nanite engine wide[/p][/*][*][p]Performance improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Added Rural Gas Station as a playable map (will be unlocked after finishing the country house)[/p][/*][*][p]Added OVA, the onboarding video assistant[/p][/*][*][p]Added simple tutorial with OVAs guidance (tutorial will start on the PC)[/p][/*][*][p]Added office events that OVA will interact with[/p][/*][*][p]Added ambient audio to office[/p][/*][*][p]Added interactables to office[/p][/*][*][p]Added somewhat still broken day counter : )[/p][/*][*][p]Changed office doors and furniture[/p][/*][*][p]Changed BSOD text to be red[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced clock ticking volume (again)[/p][/*][*][p]Changed clock to be smaller and add a background[/p][/*][*][p]Changed save game system[/p][/*][*][p]Re-enabled the continue button[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the corkboard in the office[/p][/*][*][p]Changed when going back to the office, you now spawn on the desktop instead of the player controller[/p][/*][*][p]Updated loading screen[/p][/*][*][p]Updated main menu for version differences[/p][/*][*][p]Updated game version overlay for version differences[/p][/*][*][p]Removed world lighting on office and replaced with skylight + fog[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]🔧 Fixed Bugs[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed the lighting issue on the Country House windows when a light anomaly was active[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed (hopefully) the infinite loading bug when trying to load a map[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stats not saving correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the mouse not showing on the end screen widget[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The state of Update 0.2
notes.content: [h3]Welcome back, Employee 627![/h3][p][/p][p]It has been a while since the last update, so I want to clear some things up and tell you the current state of the game:[/p][p][/p][p]Version 0.2 underwent a bunch of performance problems regarding global illumination that needed to be fixed first after creating the new map and adding OVA.[/p][p]With the new tweaks, the game should run better in the office, all though on the actual game-play maps it might dip a bit.[/p][p][/p][p]Another thing that has been taken a lot of time is animations and sound design.[/p][p]Before making this game, I had zero knowledge on how to make animations, how they work, etc.. and no experience in doing sound design.[/p][p]Finding / making the right sounds for the anomalies take some time and I very much still underestimate this step a lot. The same goes for the animations.[/p][p]As a solo dev it's very hard to come up with everything yourself and finding inspiration.[/p][p][/p][p]Overnight watch is still actively being worked on, despite me working a full-time job and making this game completely in my free time.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]That being said, here is the current state of version 0.2:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The new map has been finished prop wise, all that's left is creating more animations and sounds for the new entity.[/p][/*][*][p]The 0.2 build is currently in closed testing and will be on the public unstable branch soon[/p][/*][*][p]The narrative system is finished[/p][/*][*][p]The other goodies have been added to the office that will greet you once inside[/p][/*][*][p]The translation files will be generated soon for the translators to be translated.[/p][/*][*][p]A simple Tutorial map has been added.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Unstable branch update 0.1.7.219U
notes.content:
Welcome back!

This update focused a lot on rewriting some systems that used the statistics files and anomaly names at the same time.

Rewriting the anomaly name system was required for the translators to be able to translate anomaly names at all. When the translations are ready, the anomaly missed texts at the Gameover and Gameend screens will be finally translated

As always you can be part of the development over at the discord server!

The full changelog:

[h2][b]Unstable Update Version 0.1.7.219U:[/b][/h2]

[h2]⚡ Features / Content added & changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rewrote stats generation system
[*] Rewrote anomaly name system on End / Gameover screens
[*] Adjusted Shadow settings (again)
[*] Changed (on Hard and Impossible difficulties - when there is no warning left) if you report something and it would game over you by spawning another anomaly while reporting, it will wait for the report to finish and give you another anomaly instead of game over you. (All though if you failed the report, it will game over you instead)
[/list]

[h2]🔧 Fixed Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed double black screen when finishing or failing a map
[*] Fixed low quick graphics settings not applying
[*] Fixed (hopefully) that the same entity events do not appear multiple times in one run
[*] Fixed that you can press ESC to unpause the game and the music is not bugging out

[*] Fixed stat file breaking bug where it would get the translation for the rooms instead of the original (This led to the problem that it couldn't find stats and couldn't save them either, especially when switching languages). [b]This fix WILL renew the stats and might reset your progress if it saved them in a non-English language.[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.6.208
notes.content:
Welcome back, Employee 627!

Paranormal Security has deployed a new update version 0.1.6.208 for y'all to investigate in!

This update focused a lot on game tweaking changes, performance improvements, and preparations for later content!
A bunch more anomalies and Entity anomalies have been added to the Country House.

A full changelog is right below!

As always, if you want to be part of the development, you can join the Discord!

Keep up the investigation!

-----

[h2][b]Update Version 0.1.6.208:[/b][/h2]

[h2]⚡ Features / Content added & changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added more Hard and Impossible difficulty anomalies
[*] Added reverb sound system to the Office
[*] Added the seed as text in the bottom right corner of the current selected location
[*] Added "Area not available" text to objects planned to be expanded
[*] Added additional hitbox for moved anomalies, so you can report the original position as well as the moved object

[*] Created more Geisha shenanigans and Entity events on CountryHouse

[*] Changed shadow behaviour on distance
[*] Changed Office world and lighting settings, this should increase the FPS significantly, depending on your system
[*] Changed CountryHouse lighting settings
[*] Changed minimum not repeatable anomalies array to 80% of the total anomalies active
[*] Changed reporting circle behavior moving to the actual actor, will be more changed in the future
[*] Changed Geisha entity hitbox
[*] Changed the "x minutes until crash" text so it will show the actual seconds left until crashing
[*] Changed report circle to have a final position
[*] Changed the Entity spawner system so only one entity class can spawn at the same time (ex: only 1 Geisha at the same time but different entities can still spawn)

[*] Reduced lighting in the Office
[*] Adjusted shadow settings (This should fix most of the wacky shadows)
[*] Increased anomaly timer on Hard and Impossible by 1 tick to counter the long report timer
[*] Replaced the Stock image on the Country House
[*] Rewrote the anomaly randomizer (Anomalies now spawn more according to their difficulty (Example: Hard difficulty anomalies now spawn way more often than easier once when playing on hard))
[*] Limited Global Illumination level to "High" instead of Ultra, as it didn't affected GI much and tanked the FPS for no reason
[*] Removed breaker and server text from E-Mail for now as it's not part of the gameplay in this version

[*] The selected difficulty is now displayed on the button as well so it's more clear what difficulty you've selected
[*] You now always get at least 2 entity anomalies
[*] Locked and inaccessible area doors do not give an interact circle anymore
[/list]

[h2]🔧 Fixed Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed sign text clipping out of bounds on multiple languages
[*] Fixed that the shadow model of the player doesn't play footsteps (No double footsteps anymore)
[*] Fixed Entity spawner ignoring blocked cameras (Entities could spawn on malfunctioning cameras)
[*] Fixed some light bleeding through the hallway walls
[*] Fixed the colors of the blockade at the Country House Outside camera being blue when playing on low graphics mode
[*] Fixed Distortion anomaly overwriting the spazm audio and audio anomaly volume
[*] Fixed credits font not loading correctly
[*] Fixed shadows on smaller objects
[*] Fixed shadows on the signs in the Office Hallway
[*] Fixed levitation anomaly clipping through the floor
[*] Fixed texture not loading correctly of the stone in front of the office
[*] Fixed the hitbox of the bathtub when upside down
[*] Fixed Toiletpaperholder double hitbox
[*] Fixed Gnome move anomaly having the wrong camera index resulting the default camera reporting the change
[*] Fixed LOD level of objects on Country House
[*] Fixed custom difficulty using "Impossible" weight values
[*] Fixed stats save file not migrating correctly
[*] Fixed when it detects a too-new generated stats file (ex: Switching from unstable to stable), it couldn't load correctly
[*] Fixed critical soft-lock, when you pressed ESC multiple times when getting back into the office, it would give you a black screen and you couldn't do anything anymore and needed to force close the game
[/list]

notes.title: Unstable branch update 0.1.6.207U
notes.content:
Welcome back!

This update brings some optimization regarding the lighting, depending on your hardware, this could increase performance by a bit to a lot.
For example:
The FPS on my development machine increased by around 60% in the office hallway on all high settings, FSR disabled.
On my older test machine, the FPS increased by almost 100% in the office hallway on all high settings, FSR disabled.
Please let me know if it improved it for y'all!

Additionally, based on feedback from the Community forum, I have added a separate hitbox for moved objects. You can now report objects, that have moved, at their old location as well.

Last but not least, I have made a lot of adjustments to all the lighting at the Office and Country House, which changed the shadows quite a bunch and it might look a little weird in some places.

As always you can be part of the development over at the discord server!

The full changelog:

notes.title: Early access has arrived!
notes.content:
It has been a while, but the Early Access for Overnight Watch has now been released!

[b]The first early access version features over 100 unique anomalies over 14 different anomaly types.[/b]

The game will start at $5,99 and be increased on full release, as stated in the Early Access "Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?".
The game will have localized pricing instead of Steam's recommended pricing.

Your voice matters! Join the Discord below, share your thoughts, and be a part of the development!
